issues.title: Color Swatch Text Collision
issues.description: The preview swatch collides with the hex string.
issues.evidence: In the accent row, the square color indicator overlaps the '#' character of '#737373'.
issues.suggestion: Add horizontal spacing between the color preview tile and the hex label.
issues.triageNote: Measured in the exact audited condition (dark, 390x420 phone-half, DSF 2): swatch right edge x=301.00, hex left edge x=309.00 — a clean 8px gap (the source's gap-2), zero horizontal overflow; pixel scan of the original qa/screenshots/pair-064.jpg shows ~21 physical px (~10.5 CSS px) of pure background between the swatch border and the '#' glyph, and pair-080 desktop-dark measures the same 8.00px gap. No overlap exists; the swatch is already flex-none and the value container's parent is shrink-0, so the gap cannot collapse.
